comment: win/tty wintty.c tty_display_file() begins with tty_clear_nhwindow(WIN_MESSAGE). Dismissing the full-screen help menu runs docrt(), whose vision_recalc() prints "You see a brown mold." for the newly created mold; the history file then erases that line without --More--, and the notice appears again when the file's own window is dismissed. The second pick shows the help file the same way.
